content: Hero patterns in fashion sites: full-bleed image with text overlay dominates (55.4% of fashion pages vs 35.7% gallery-wide); 81.3% use photography as hero media. Marquee tickers (brand words, press strips, promos) are a recurring editorial device implemented cheaply as CSS keyframe loops with auto-cloning; must pause under prefers-reduced-motion. Hero slideshows mix autoplay video/images with separate mobile media. Full-width video breaks used as editorial pacing.
